backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing editable site pages with admin-gated CRUD operations and default home content.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of major frontend files across layout, pages, hooks, and admin UI.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark theme tokens and applying global background and text colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting the document title and loading the main React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with root layout and routes for public pages and the admin page.
frontend/src/components/Admin/AdminAcces: Protects admin content by checking authentication and admin role, showing login or denial states as needed.
frontend/src/components/Admin/contentDef: Provides fallback default values for editable home hero and contact information fields.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer layout showing institute info, quick links, backend-driven contact details, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Responsive site header with navigation and conditional Admin link shown only to authenticated admins.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Page wrapper composing the header, routed content area, and footer for consistent layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthz.ts: Checks whether the current authenticated identity is an admin using the actor’s isCallerAdmin method.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login, and logout via a React context using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks with no current functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteContent.ts: Fetches and updates page content through backend actor calls and exposes helpers for home and contact page data.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders a static About page describing the organization, its mission, and services.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Provides an admin-only interface for editing home and contact page content, including save and logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdmissionsCoachingPag: React page showing admissions and coaching services with a contact form and service cards.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Homepage with hero content, mission preview, key features, and navigation to other sections.
frontend/src/pages/NiosStreamsSubjectsPa: Page describing NIOS streams and subjects with overview text and categorized subject cards.
frontend/src/pages/VisionPage.tsx: Vision and mission page with motivational content and feature cards about NIOS benefits.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for getting, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s website requirements, theme, content needs, and feature list for Mastermind Study Circle. Includes architectural notes, existing features, and metadata for project state versioning.
